section.title: Backward safety
section.p: Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist may operate when the following conditions are met.

li.p: The trunk and doors are closed
The Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) is released
The gear is shifted to R (Reverse)
Your driving speed is below 10 km/h (6 mph) (detecting pedestrians)
Your driving speed is below 4 km/h (detecting objects)
Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist components such as the rearview camera and the rear ultrasonic sensors are in normal conditions

After the gear is shifted to R (Reverse), braking assist is released after 5 minutes. Immediately depress the brake pedal before release and check vehicle surroundings. Braking assist is also released in the following conditions when:
The brake pedal is depressed with sufficient power

entry.p: When Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist activates, a line appears behind the vehicle image in the instrument cluster.

li.p: When Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist is activated while reversing, braking control will be released after 5 minutes and the Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) will be engaged.
Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist operates only once after shifting the gear to R (Reverse). To reactivate Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist, shift the gear from another gear to R (Reverse).
